programmes.d: A preacher (Van Heflin) with a reckless past rebuilds a church after the Civil War with a teenage girl (Joanne Woodward) from the hills.
During the Civil War, a Southerner joins the Union Army and is accused of leaking information to the Confederates.
The wife (Angela Lansbury) of a roving marshal (Randolph Scott) wants him to quit, but first he has to clean up Medicine Bend.
Three outlaws join a loner (Randolph Scott) and another man's wife (Nancy Gates), who was kidnapped by Indians.
A Chicago hotel desk clerk (Jack Lemmon) talks a trail boss (Glenn Ford) into taking him on a cattle drive to Mexico.
A new lawman (Bill Elliott) punches out cattle rustlers who like to shoot sheriffs.
Three trappers become scouts for a cavalry captain (Guy Madison) who loses his fort to a hated colonel (Robert Preston).
Absent from Custer's Last Stand, an Army captain (Randolph Scott) volunteers for the Little Bighorn burial detail.
A stagecoach driver seeks to capture "The Monk," a notorious highwayman, in order to clear himself.
A posse led by an alcoholic sheriff pursues the Drune family after they rob a wealthy rancher. Several days later, the Drunes are all dead, the sheriff is wounded, and the money has disappeared.
A man whose life was saved by an outlaw shows his gratitude by reluctantly assisting in a stagecoach robbery.
An ex-convict (Phil Carey) and his girlfriend (Martha Hyer) cannot start over until they stop Butch Cassidy's (Gene Evans) gang.
A fugitive lawman (Audie Murphy) leaves Mexico to get the Texas saloon boss (Broderick Crawford) who framed him and killed his brother.
Two guys (Rod Cameron, Wayne Morris) find stages hijacked for sale to Rebels.
Joe goes looking for his missing father in the desert, then strange villagers take him captive; he finds his father and plans to escape, taking with him a woman that he has fallen for.
A woman writer (Karen Valentine) and a cavalry widow (Sandra Will) seek Billy the Kid.
